overview: A holdover tenancy occurs when a tenant remains in possession of a property after their lease agreement has expired or terminated. This situation is generally governed by a "holdover clause" in the lease, or by local laws (such as Section 116 of the Transfer of Property Act 1882 in some jurisdictions) that determine the new legal relationship between the landlord and tenant.
